description.en: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers, including agricultural, construction, domestic, home-based, and other casual workers.

benefit_summary.en: The scheme provides a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60. The worker makes an age-based monthly contribution and the Central Government contributes an equal amount under current scheme terms.

eligibility_summary.en: An unorganised worker aged 18 through 40 with monthly income up to Rs 15,000 may join if not an income-tax payer and not covered by the specified EPFO, ESIC, or government-funded NPS social-security schemes.

prompt.en: What is your age in completed years?
What is your monthly income in rupees?
Do you work in the unorganised sector?
Are you covered by EPFO, ESIC, or a government-funded NPS scheme?

description.en: The worker is at least 18 years old.
The worker is no more than 40 years old at entry.
Monthly income is no more than Rs 15,000.
The applicant is an unorganised worker.
The applicant has specified statutory social-security coverage.

name.en: Mobile number for registration and updates

instruction.en: Register through the official Maandhan portal or visit an authorised Common Service Centre.
Provide the required identity and bank details and review the contribution for the entry age.
Maintain enough balance for contribution auto-debits and retain the pension account details.
